ios.desc:
Break the habit build better days
ZenStreak is a clean, science-informed tracker that turns one small daily check-in into the momentum you need to quit porn for good.

Quit the cycle, one check-in at a time.
• ZenStreak turns a 5-second daily log into visible progress that helps you leave porn behind.


Why ZenStreak works

• Visual streaks that motivate. Mark each day clean or not-clean .Watch your progress light up.
• Weekly picker. Jump back a week in one tap to see where triggers hit.
• History tab. Zoom out month-by-month to spot patterns and celebrate long runs.

• Pocket photo. Pin an image that reminds you why you're doing this; see it every time you log.
• 100 % private. Your data stays on-device no ads, no tracking.
• Designed for calm. Gentle haptics, zen-inspired UI, and no shame language just honest feedback.

How to use it
	1.	Add a motivating photo.
	2.	Check in once a day.
	3.	Review weekly trends, adjust triggers, repeat.

That's it no surveys, no clutter, no judgment. Tiny, consistent steps compound into lasting change.



Try ZenStreak free for 14 days. Cancel any time.

Ready to start a cleaner streak? Download ZenStreak and log today's win

quotes.text:
The reason why I got into programming like many other people was because I feel in love 
with video games. Zelda, and Mario on the N64 were some of my favorite. But I also 
started watching adult content (pron) at a very early age.

I was able to navigate the web more naturally than other people. And so my brain was 
hooked.

It's been more than a decade carrying this unwanted habit. After my long term girlfriend
almost ended things with me about my use I decided it was time to quit.

I tried other apps to quit. Their attempt was honest and at times good. But they just
felt short of what I was actually looking for. What ended up working for me was: having
a notecard on my desk and a checkbox for every day, that I look at daily.

It's actually comically simple. But it worked for me. So I decided to build a native iOS
app. Partly because I didn't want the notecards to pile up and make a mess. 
But also to learn Swift, SwiftUI, and SwiftData.

I had fun making the app for myself. I've been using it for about 8 months now on my 
development Xcode build ... I finally got around to making it available for others.

Check it out if you're interested. thanks for reading.
